questions: Is a route the same in both directions, with the same fare (Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle), or should each direction be added separately?
Should only station staff be able to add routes and change fares (for example with a password), while passengers can only look up fares?

If there is no direct route between two stops, should passengers just be told there is no route, or should the system combine routes (for example Circle to Madina, then Madina to Adenta) and add up the fares?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
